user.description: Choose how you would like to configure your Eufy light.

menu_options.cloud_login: Sign in with Eufy Account (Keep Eufy App Working)

local_pairing.title: Fully local
local_pairing.description: Hold the physical button on your Eufy light controller until the lights blink to enter pairing mode. Home Assistant will generate an encryption key and bind directly to the light without needing a Eufy account.

cloud_login.title: Sign in with Eufy Account
cloud_login.description: Sign in once with your Eufy credentials to automatically retrieve your account's User ID so both Home Assistant and the Eufy app can control the light.

data.serial_number: 16-Character Serial starting with T8L... (optional if auto-detected)
data.country: Two-Letter Country Code (e.g., US, GB, DE)

2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
2fa.description: Enter the verification code sent to your email or phone.

manual.title: Manual Configuration
manual.description: Enter your light's Bluetooth MAC address, 16-character serial number, and Eufy User ID manually.

error.invalid_user_id: User ID must be at least 16 characters.
